Métodos: Se elaboró una guía de práctica clínica utilizando la metodología GRADE. Se formularon cinco preguntas clínicas estructuradas en formato PICO y se realizó una revisión sistemática de la evidencia en bases de datos biomédicas. La certeza de la evidencia se evaluó considerando el riesgo de sesgo, la consistencia, la precisión y la aplicabilidad. Se utilizó un marco de la Evidencia a la Decisión (EtD) para formular recomendaciones. Resultados: Se recomienda la vacunación materna entre las 32 y 36 semanas de gestación para reducir la enfermedad grave y las hospitalizaciones por VSR en lactantes (recomendación fuerte a favor, evidencia alta). En lactantes no protegidos por vacunación materna, se recomienda administrar nirsevimab (recomendación fuerte a favor, evidencia alta). En prematuros y en poblaciones de alto riesgo, nirsevimab se considera la estrategia preferida, con recomendaciones fuertes o condicionales según el subgrupo y la disponibilidad de evidencia directa. Conclusión: Las estrategias de inmunoprofilaxis contra el VSR, basadas en la vacunación materna y el uso de un anticuerpo monoclonal (nirsevimab), tienen el potencial de reducir sustancialmente la carga de enfermedad en lactantes en el Perú, y su implementación programada debe considerarse una prioridad de salud pública.
papers.abstract_zh: 简介:原发性呼吸系统病毒 (VSR) 是感染呼吸道感染的主要原因,代表着对疾病、住院和死亡的重要影响,特别是在秘鲁的下水道和中水道中的生命初期。目的:为秘鲁 VSR 的乳制品预防坟墓提供证据。方法:使用 GRADE 方法对临床实践进行详细说明。我们以 PICO 格式为临床预构建公式,并以生物医学数据为基础对证据系统进行修订。评估证据的证明要考虑其有效性、一致性、精确性和应用性。使用公式化建议的决策证据 (EtD)。结果:Se recomienda la vacunación materna entre las 32 y 36 semanas de gestación para reducir la enfermedadgrave y las Hospitalizaciones por VSR en milkantes(建议帮个忙,evidencia alta)。Enlacantes no protegidos por vacunación materna,se recomienda administrar 尼塞韦单抗 (recomendación fuerte avant,evidencia alta)。在准备工作和上级政策的实施过程中,尼塞韦单抗 会优先考虑策略,并推荐符合条件的子组和直接证据。结论:针对 VSR 的免疫预防策略、母体真空和抗抗单克隆抗体 (尼塞韦单抗) 的使用、降低秘鲁乳杆菌维持能力的潜力、以及实施需要考虑的计划公共健康的优先事项。

papers.title: Epidemiology of SARS-CoV-2, Influenza, RSV, and Human Metapneumovirus Across the COVID-19 Era: An Eight-Year Tertiary-Center Study in Saudi Arabia
papers.abstract: Background: Respiratory tract infections (RTIs) caused by viruses are a public health problem, contributing to hospital admissions and morbidity worldwide. The COVID-19 pandemic substantially altered the detection patterns of respiratory viruses through public health interventions. Longitudinal data on these changes and viral seasonality remain limited in Saudi Arabia. This eight-year study evaluated epidemiological and seasonal patterns of major respiratory viruses across the COVID-19 era at a major Saudi tertiary care center. Methods: A retrospective observational study was conducted at King Khalid University Hospital, Riyadh, from October 2017 to December 2025. PCR-confirmed detections for SARS-CoV-2, Influenza A, Influenza B, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), and human metapneumovirus (HMPV) were extracted from the hospital Laboratory Information System. Demographics, co-detection, seasonality, and length of stay (LOS) were analyzed across four eras spanning the pre-COVID-19, lockdown, restriction, and post-restriction periods using descriptive statistics, the Kruskal–Wallis test, and multivariable negative binomial regression. Results: Among 5708 confirmed respiratory viral detection episodes, SARS-CoV-2 was the most frequently detected (52.5%), followed by Influenza A (19.1%), RSV (16.4%), Influenza B (8.4%), and HMPV (3.6%). Before the pandemic, Influenza A accounted for the largest proportion of detected episodes (71.1%), with detections clustering particularly during autumn and winter seasons, whereas SARS-CoV-2 accounted for the majority of detected episodes during the lockdown and restriction eras (97.4% and 93.2%). The post-restriction era became more diverse, with RSV being detected in substantial proportions (28.3%), showing prominent winter activity. RSV and HMPV predominantly affected children aged 0–5 years, whereas SARS-CoV-2 was more frequently detected among older adults. Among adults, older age was associated with prolonged LOS; Influenza A and HMPV were associated with shorter stays compared to SARS-CoV-2. Among children, no virus was independently associated with LOS after adjustment for age and sex; however, older age was associated with longer hospital stays. Conclusion: The observed detection patterns of major respiratory viruses shifted substantially across the COVID-19 eras, with notable post-restriction diversification among observed positive detections. LOS was associated with age in both adults and children and with virus type among adults, supporting continued surveillance to guide preventive and clinical strategies.

analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed the epidemiology of respiratory viruses, including respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), across the COVID-19 era in Saudi Arabia. It found that SARS-CoV-2 became the most frequently detected virus, surpassing Influenza A, which was dominant before the pandemic. RSV showed increased detection in the post-restriction period, with notable seasonal activity. The study highlights the impact of public health interventions on viral detection patterns and underscores the need for continued surveillance to adapt clinical and preventive strategies. However, the retrospective design and reliance on hospital data limit the generalizability of the findings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 由病毒引起的呼吸道感染 (RTI) 是一个公共卫生问题,导致全世界住院人数和发病率增加。本研究旨在评估整个 COVID-19 时代主要呼吸道病毒的流行病学和季节性模式。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2017 年 10 月至 2025 年 12 月在利雅得哈立德国王大学医院进行了一项回顾性观察研究。该研究包括来自医院实验室信息系统的 SARS-CoV-2、甲型流感、乙型流感、呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 和人类偏肺病毒 (HMPV) 的 PCR 确认检测。
elements_zh.methods: 使用描述性统计、Kruskal-Wallis 检验和多变量负二项式回归,对跨越 COVID-19 之前、封锁、限制和限制后四个时期的人口统计、共同检测、季节性和住院时间 (LOS) 进行了分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 5708 例确诊的呼吸道病毒检测事件中,SARS-CoV-2 检测频率最高(52.5%),其次是甲型流感(19.1%)、RSV(16.4%)、乙型流感(8.4%)和 HMPV(3.6%)。在大流行之前,甲型流感占检测到的病例的最大比例(71.1%),检测集中在秋冬季节,而SARS-CoV-2占封锁和限制时期检测到的病例的大部分(97.4%和93.2%)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在 COVID-19 时代,观察到的主要呼吸道病毒的检测模式发生了很大变化,观察到的阳性检测在限制后出现了显着的多样化。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持监测继续指导预防和临床策略,特别是在了解呼吸道病毒检测和住院模式的动态变化方面。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其回顾性设计和对医院数据的依赖而受到限制,这些数据可能无法代表更广泛的人群。由于这些限制,证据的强度中等。

papers.title_zh: COVID-19 时代的 SARS-CoV-2、流感、RSV 和人类偏肺病毒的 流行病学:沙特阿拉伯三级中心为期八年的研究
papers.source_body_en: Background: Respiratory tract infections (RTIs) caused by viruses are a public health problem, contributing to hospital admissions and morbidity worldwide. The COVID-19 pandemic substantially altered the detection patterns of respiratory viruses through public health interventions. Longitudinal data on these changes and viral seasonality remain limited in Saudi Arabia. This eight-year study evaluated epidemiological and seasonal patterns of major respiratory viruses across the COVID-19 era at a major Saudi tertiary care center. Methods: A retrospective observational study was conducted at King Khalid University Hospital, Riyadh, from October 2017 to December 2025. PCR-confirmed detections for SARS-CoV-2, Influenza A, Influenza B, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), and human metapneumovirus (HMPV) were extracted from the hospital Laboratory Information System. Demographics, co-detection, seasonality, and length of stay (LOS) were analyzed across four eras spanning the pre-COVID-19, lockdown, restriction, and post-restriction periods using descriptive statistics, the Kruskal–Wallis test, and multivariable negative binomial regression. Results: Among 5708 confirmed respiratory viral detection episodes, SARS-CoV-2 was the most frequently detected (52.5%), followed by Influenza A (19.1%), RSV (16.4%), Influenza B (8.4%), and HMPV (3.6%). Before the pandemic, Influenza A accounted for the largest proportion of detected episodes (71.1%), with detections clustering particularly during autumn and winter seasons, whereas SARS-CoV-2 accounted for the majority of detected episodes during the lockdown and restriction eras (97.4% and 93.2%). The post-restriction era became more diverse, with RSV being detected in substantial proportions (28.3%), showing prominent winter activity. RSV and HMPV predominantly affected children aged 0–5 years, whereas SARS-CoV-2 was more frequently detected among older adults. Among adults, older age was associated with prolonged LOS; Influenza A and HMPV were associated with shorter stays compared to SARS-CoV-2. Among children, no virus was independently associated with LOS after adjustment for age and sex; however, older age was associated with longer hospital stays. Conclusion: The observed detection patterns of major respiratory viruses shifted substantially across the COVID-19 eras, with notable post-restriction diversification among observed positive detections. LOS was associated with age in both adults and children and with virus type among adults, supporting continued surveillance to guide preventive and clinical strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:由病毒引起的呼吸道感染(RTI)是一个公共卫生问题,导致全世界住院和发病。COVID-19 大流行通过公共卫生干预措施极大地改变了呼吸道病毒的检测模式。沙特阿拉伯有关这些变化和病毒季节性的纵向数据仍然有限。这项为期八年的研究评估了沙特阿拉伯一家主要三级护理中心在整个 COVID-19 时代主要呼吸道病毒的流行病学和季节性模式。方法:2017 年 10 月至 2025 年 12 月在利雅得哈立德国王大学医院进行了一项回顾性观察研究。从医院实验室信息系统中提取了 SARS-CoV-2、甲型流感、乙型流感、呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 和人类偏肺病毒 (HMPV) 的 PCR 确诊检测结果。使用描述性统计、Kruskal-Wallis 检验和多变量负二项式回归,对跨越 COVID-19 之前、封锁、限制和限制后四个时期的人口统计、共同检测、季节性和住院时间 (LOS) 进行了分析。结果:在 5708 例确诊的呼吸道病毒检测事件中,SARS-CoV-2 检测频率最高(52.5%),其次是甲型流感(19.1%)、RSV(16.4%)、乙型流感(8.4%)和 HMPV(3.6%)。在大流行之前,甲型流感占检测到的病例的最大比例(71.1%),检测集中在秋冬季节,而SARS-CoV-2占封锁和限制时期检测到的病例的大部分(97.4%和93.2%)。后限制时代变得更加多样化,RSV 检测到的比例很高(28.3%),显示出冬季活动突出。RSV 和 HMPV 主要影响 0-5 岁儿童,而 SARS-CoV-2 在老年人中更常见。在成年人中,年龄较大与 LOS 延长有关;与 SARS-CoV-2 相比,甲型流感和 HMPV 的停留时间较短。在儿童中,调整年龄和性别后,没有病毒与 LOS 独立相关;然而,年龄越大,住院时间越长。结论:在 COVID-19 时代,观察到的主要呼吸道病毒的检测模式发生了很大变化,观察到的阳性检测在限制后出现了显着的多样化。LOS 与成人和儿童的年龄以及成人的病毒类型相关,支持持续的 监测 来指导预防和临床策略。

papers.abstract: Abstract Pneumonia is diagnosed based on clinical symptoms and radiological features. It can be caused by a variety of pathogens including bacterial, mycobacterial, viral, fungal, and other atypical organisms. Most bacterial community-acquired pneumonia is due to Streptococcus pneumoniae, which is normally treated with penicillin and can be risk stratified using the CURB-65 score. Atypical organisms require macrolides. Hospital-acquired pneumonia involves Gram-negative or resistant organisms and treatment depends on local sensitivities. Viral pneumonias can include influenza and COVID-19, with antivirals used only in specific cases. Immunocompromised patients may develop invasive fungal infections such as Pneumocystis jiroveci pneumonia or invasive aspergillosis requiring targeted antifungals.

papers.title: Clinical Characteristics and Outcomes of Respiratory Viral Infections in Pediatric Cancer Patients, Single center experience
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Respiratory viral (RV) infections cause morbidity and mortality in immunocompromised pediatric patients undergoing cancer treatment. The burden of RV infections in pediatric oncology populations from low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) remain limited. We aimed to detect the prevalence of viruses causing respiratory infections among pediatric patients with cancer and guide empiric therapy and improve patient outcomes. Methods Retrospectively we collected nasopharyngeal swabs and clinical and demographic data from pediatric patients under cancer treatment with respiratory symptoms at Children’s Cancer Hospital Egypt-57357 from September 2023 until March 2025. Samples were tested using multiplex PCR for 16 respiratory viruses. Results A total of 1710 samples were collected from 784 patients with a median age of 7 years and a male-to-female ratio of 1.26:1. Viral pathogens were detected in 1037 swabs (60.6%). The most frequently identified virus was human rhinovirus (HRV) (51.3%), followed by parainfluenza virus (PIV) (9%), respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) (8%), SARS-CoV-2 (6.4%), and human metapneumovirus (HmpV) (5.8%). Co-infections were observed in 13% of samples, commonly involving RSV, PIV, and adenovirus. The main symptoms were fever (85.7%), lower respiratory tract infection (LRTI) (59.4%), and cough (57.7%). HRV were associated with fever (p=0.01), cough (p=0.02), and hospital admission (p=0.006). PIV infection were associated with increased hospital admission (p=0.04) and need for inotropes (p=0.02), while HmpV was significantly related to LRTI (p=0.01). There was no statistically significant association between virus type and mortality (p=0.64). When correlating patient characteristics with clinical symptoms and outcomes, several significant associations were found. Lower neutrophil count (<500) correlated with rhinorrhea (p<0.001), oxygen need (p=0.01), hospital admission (p=0.001) and intensive care unit (ICU) admission (p=0.04). Female sex was significantly associated with oxygen requirement (p=0.03) and ICU admission (p=0.02); and patients with hematologic malignancies were more likely to require oxygen support (p=0.01). Conclusion RV infections are common among pediatric cancer patients presenting with respiratory symptoms, with predominance of HRV and linked to key clinical manifestations and hospital admission. Host factors such as female sex, hematology tumors, and profound neutropenia were also associated with increased illness severity and need for supportive care. However, mortality did not significantly differ among virus types, suggesting that while RV infections contribute substantially to morbidity, mortality in immunocompromised children likely depends on multifactorial host and disease-related factors.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to detect the prevalence of viruses causing respiratory infections among pediatric cancer patients and guide empiric therapy. Conducted at Children’s Cancer Hospital Egypt-57357 from September 2023 to March 2025, it collected 1710 nasopharyngeal swabs from 784 patients. Multiplex PCR identified 1037 positive samples, with respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) being the second most common pathogen. RSV was associated with increased hospital admission and need for inotropes, while human metapneumovirus (HmpV) was linked to lower respiratory tract infections. Host factors like female sex, hematology tumors, and neutropenia correlated with severe illness and supportive care needs. However, no significant association was found between virus type and mortality. The study highlights the importance of RSV in respiratory morbidity among pediatric cancer patients but lacks data on generalisability and mortality factors.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 呼吸道病毒(RV)感染可导致免疫功能低下的儿科癌症患者罹患疾病并发生死亡率。低收入和中等收入国家(LMICs)儿科肿瘤人群中RV感染的负担仍有限。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们回顾性收集了2023年9月至2025年3月埃及第57357儿童癌症医院有呼吸道症状的癌症治疗儿童患者的鼻咽拭子以及临床和人口统计数据。共收集了784名患者的1710份样本,中位年龄为7岁,男女比例为1.26:1。
elements_zh.methods: 使用多重 PCR 对样本进行了 16 种呼吸道病毒检测。当将患者特征与临床症状和结果关联起来时,发现了一些显着的关联。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 1037 份拭子(60.6%)中检测到病毒病原体。最常见的病毒是人鼻病毒 (HRV) (51.3%),其次是副流感病毒 (PIV) (9%)、呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) (8%)、SARS-CoV-2 (6.4%) 和人偏肺病毒 (HmpV) (5.8%)。13% 的样本中观察到混合感染,通常涉及 RSV、PIV 和腺病毒。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: RSV 感染与入院率增加 (p=0.04) 和正性肌力药物需求增加 (p=0.02) 相关,而 HmpV 与 LRTI 显着相关 (p=0.01)。宿主 因素(例如女性、血液肿瘤和严重中性粒细胞减少症)也与疾病严重程度增加和支持性护理需求增加相关。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,RSV 感染对儿童癌症患者的发病率有很大影响,强调了免疫功能低下人群需要有针对性的 监测 和管理策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 病毒类型和 死亡率 之间没有统计学上的显着关联 (p=0.64)。所提供的证据并未报告研究结果的普遍性或研究设计中的潜在偏差。

HRV were associated with fever (p=0.01), cough (p=0.02), and hospital admission (p=0.006). PIV infection were associated with increased hospital admission (p=0.04) and need for inotropes (p=0.02), while HmpV was significantly related to LRTI (p=0.01). There was no statistically significant association between virus type and mortality (p=0.64). When correlating patient characteristics with clinical symptoms and outcomes, several significant associations were found. Lower neutrophil count (<500) correlated with rhinorrhea (p<0.001), oxygen need (p=0.01), hospital admission (p=0.001) and intensive care unit (ICU) admission (p=0.04). Female sex was significantly associated with oxygen requirement (p=0.03) and ICU admission (p=0.02); and patients with hematologic malignancies were more likely to require oxygen support (p=0.01). Conclusion RV infections are common among pediatric cancer patients presenting with respiratory symptoms, with predominance of HRV and linked to key clinical manifestations and hospital admission. Host factors such as female sex, hematology tumors, and profound neutropenia were also associated with increased illness severity and need for supportive care. However, mortality did not significantly differ among virus types, suggesting that while RV infections contribute substantially to morbidity, mortality in immunocompromised children likely depends on multifactorial host and disease-related factors.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 呼吸道病毒 (RV) 感染会导致患有癌症 治疗 的免疫功能低下儿科患者发病和 死亡率。低收入和中等收入国家 (LMIC) 儿童肿瘤人群的 RV 感染负担仍然有限。我们的目的是检测引起儿科癌症患者呼吸道感染的病毒的 患病率,并指导经验性治疗和改善患者的治疗结果。方法 回顾性收集了 2023 年 9 月至 2025 年 3 月埃及 57357 儿童癌症医院有呼吸道症状的 治疗 癌症儿童患者的鼻咽拭子以及临床和人口统计数据。使用多重 PCR 对样本进行了 16 种呼吸道病毒检测。结果共收集784例患者1710份样本,中位年龄7岁,男女比例1.26:1。在 1037 份拭子(60.6%)中检测到病毒病原体。最常见的病毒是人鼻病毒 (HRV) (51.3%),其次是副流感病毒 (PIV) (9%)、呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) (8%)、SARS-CoV-2 (6.4%) 和人偏肺病毒 (HmpV) (5.8%)。13% 的样本中观察到混合感染,通常涉及 RSV、PIV 和腺病毒。主要症状为发热(85.7%)、下呼吸道感染(LRTI)(59.4%)和咳嗽(57.7%)。HRV 与发烧 (p=0.01)、咳嗽 (p=0.02) 和入院 (p=0.006) 相关。PIV 感染与入院率增加 (p=0.04) 和正性肌力药物需求增加 (p=0.02) 相关,而 HmpV 与 LRTI 显着相关 (p=0.01)。病毒类型和 死亡率 之间没有统计学上的显着关联 (p=0.64)。当将患者特征与临床症状和结果关联起来时,发现了一些显着的关联。中性粒细胞计数较低(<500)与鼻漏(p<0.001)、需氧量(p=0.01)、入院(p=0.001)和入院重症监护病房(p=0.04)相关。女性性别与需氧量 (p=0.03) 和入住 ICU (p=0.02) 显着相关;患有血液系统恶性肿瘤的患者更有可能需要氧气支持(p=0.01)。结论 RV 感染在有呼吸道症状的儿童癌症患者中很常见,以 HRV 为主,且与关键临床表现和入院情况相关。宿主 因素(例如女性、血液肿瘤和严重中性粒细胞减少症)也与疾病严重程度增加和支持性护理需求增加相关。然而,死亡率 在病毒类型之间没有显着差异,这表明虽然 RV 感染对发病率有很大影响,但免疫功能低下儿童的 死亡率 可能取决于多因素 宿主 和疾病相关因素。

papers.title: Maternal vaccination with RSVpreF and risk of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
papers.abstract: Background A bivalent respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) prefusion F protein–based vaccine (RSVpreF) was approved in the United States in August 2023 for use during pregnancy to prevent infant RSV-associated lower respiratory tract disease. The pivotal phase 3 trial identified a numerical imbalance in hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP) that did not reach statistical significance; postmarketing observational studies have since reported inconsistent findings. We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis to assess this association. Methods We searched MEDLINE, Embase, CENTRAL, Scopus, ClinicalTrials.gov , and WHO ICTRP from inception to Jan 26, 2026, for randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and observational studies comparing HDP outcomes in RSVpreF-vaccinated versus unvaccinated or placebo-receiving pregnant individuals. Unadjusted risk ratios (RRs) were pooled using a random-effects model; adjusted estimates from observational studies were pooled separately by inverse variance methods. This study is registered with PROSPERO (CRD420251026835). Results Nine studies were included (3 RCTs, 6 retrospective cohort studies; n = 148,267). RSVpreF vaccination was associated with a small but statistically significant increase in overall HDP risk (RR 1·08, 95% CI 1·02–1·13; p = 0·004; I 2 = 44%), driven by the observational studies group (1·08, 1·02–1·14; I 2 = 61%); RCTs showed a directionally consistent but non-significant RR (1·12, 0·87–1·43; I 2 = 0%). The association was attributable to gestational hypertension, with no significant association for preeclampsia/eclampsia. Conclusion Maternal RSVpreF vaccination was associated with a small increase in HDP attributable to gestational hypertension and driven primarily by observational studies, in which residual confounding remains possible. The benefits of infant RSV prevention remain substantial, and these findings support continued postmarketing surveillance and informed shared decision-making.

papers.title: An Appraisal of the Potential Downstream Benefits of RSV Vaccination in Older Adults
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) has long been underrecognized as a significant pathogen in older adults, despite accumulating evidence of its substantial morbidity and mortality burden in this population. While RSV vaccination is now well established as an effective intervention for preventing lower respiratory tract disease, this narrative review examines whether its public health value may extend beyond these primary clinical endpoints. A targeted search of Scopus and Web of Science from database inception to May 2026 was conducted to identify biological, epidemiological, observational, interventional, and modelling evidence relevant to potential downstream vaccine effects. The available evidence potentially supports hypotheses concerning possible reductions in cardiovascular complications and secondary bacterial infections, possible decreases in transmission to younger household contacts, and potential preservation of functional status and independence. However, the strength of evidence varies substantially across these outcomes. Cardiovascular protection has not been independently demonstrated in randomized trials, bacterial and antimicrobial‐use outcomes have rarely been prespecified, real‐world household transmission studies are unavailable, and functional trajectories may be strongly modified by baseline frailty and pre‐existing disability. RSV vaccination in older adults therefore remains a well‐validated strategy for preventing acute respiratory disease, whereas its proposed broader effects should be regarded as biologically plausible but incompletely demonstrated benefits. Future studies should incorporate prespecified cardiovascular, bacterial, transmission, geriatric, and functional outcomes, with particular attention to frailty, antimicrobial use, and longer‐term follow‐up.

papers.title: Eligibility-Identification Difficulty and Self-Reported Preventive Care Implementation Among Japanese Primary Care Physicians.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background Primary care is an important setting for prevention, but implementation gaps may arise before clinicians can identify patients eligible for preventive services. We described self‐reported preventive care implementation among Japanese primary care physicians and examined whether lower implementation co‐occurred with eligibility‐identification difficulty. Methods We conducted a nationwide web‐based cross‐sectional survey of physician members of the Japan Primary Care Association from May to June 2025. Respondents reported recommendation consistency for 30 preventive services, difficulty identifying eligible patients, and perceived barriers. Service‐level implementation and eligibility‐identification difficulty were summarized in a two‐axis map. Results Among 258 respondents, 56.2% reported structured preventive care training and 53.9% used outpatient reminders. “Mostly achieved” recommendation was relatively high for hypertension, diabetes, and dyslipidaemia screening and influenza vaccination, but low for screening for domestic violence, chlamydia/gonorrhea, abdominal aortic aneurysm, anxiety, and depression, respiratory syncytial virus vaccination, and folic acid counseling. Difficulty identifying eligible patients was highest for domestic violence screening (14.0%), chlamydia/gonorrhea screening (13.6%), hepatitis C screening (10.5%), and respiratory syncytial virus vaccination (7.8%). Common barriers were time constraints, insufficient knowledge or skills, low patient interest, and financial or reimbursement issues. Conclusions Self‐reported implementation varied substantially across services. Some low‐implementation services also involved eligibility‐identification difficulty, suggesting an upstream implementation problem. Japanese primary care may need systems that make eligibility visible through training, reminders, prompts, registries, and team‐based workflows.
papers.journal: Journal of General and Family Medicine

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 初级保健是预防的重要场所,但在临床医生识别出符合预防性服务资格的患者之前,可能会出现实施差距。我们描述了日本初级保健医生自我报告的预防保健实施情况,并检查了较低的实施情况是否与资格识别困难同时发生。方法 我们于 2025 年 5 月至 6 月对日本初级保健协会的医生成员进行了一项全国性的网络横断面调查。受访者报告了 30 种预防性服务的推荐一致性、识别合格患者的困难以及感知到的障碍。服务水平实施和资格识别难度总结在双轴图中。结果 在 258 名受访者中,56.2% 的受访者表示接受了结构化的预防护理培训,53.9% 的受访者使用了门诊提醒。高血压、糖尿病、血脂异常筛查和流感 疫苗接种 的“基本达到”建议相对较高,但家庭暴力、衣原体/淋病、腹主动脉瘤、焦虑和抑郁、呼吸道合胞病毒 疫苗接种 和叶酸咨询的筛查建议较低。家庭暴力筛查 (14.0%)、衣原体/淋病筛查 (13.6%)、丙型肝炎筛查 (10.5%) 和 呼吸道合胞病毒 疫苗接种 (7.8%) 筛选合格患者的难度最高。常见的障碍是时间限制、知识或技能不足、患者兴趣低以及财务或报销问题。结论 不同服务的自我报告实施情况差异很大。一些低实施服务还涉及资格识别困难,表明存在上游实施问题。日本初级保健可能需要通过培训、提醒、提示、登记和基于团队的工作流程使资格可见的系统。

papers.title: Durability of RSV Prefusion F Vaccine Protection across Two RSV Seasons
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is an important cause of hospitalization and death among older adults. Although first-season vaccine effectiveness against RSV-related hospitalization has been demonstrated for the bivalent RSV prefusion F protein-based vaccine (RSVpreF), data regarding the durability of protection beyond a single RSV season are lacking. METHODS: In a pragmatic, open-label trial with individual randomization, participants 60 years of age or older were assigned in a 1:1 ratio to receive RSVpreF vaccine or no vaccine during the 2024-2025 winter season. Participants were followed through the 2025-2026 winter season to evaluate protection across two consecutive RSV seasons after a single vaccine dose. The primary endpoint was RSV-related respiratory tract disease (RTD) hospitalization. Secondary endpoints included RSV-related and all-cause lower respiratory tract disease hospitalization, all-cause respiratory hospitalization, all-cause cardiorespiratory hospitalization, and all-cause mortality. RESULTS: Of 131,379 participants who underwent random assignment, 130,991 were included in the intention-to-treat population during the second season. During the second RSV season, the incidence rate of RSV-related RTD hospitalization was 0.11 events per 1000 person-years in the RSVpreF group and 0.25 events per 1000 person-years in the control group, corresponding to a vaccine effectiveness of 56.2% (95% confidence interval [CI], -12.4% to 84.8%), as compared with 83.3% (95% CI, 42.9%-96.9%) during the first season. Across both seasons, the corresponding incidence rates were 0.11 and 0.37 events per 1000 person-years in the RSVpreF and control groups, respectively, with a vaccine effectiveness of 70.6% (95% CI, 39.1%-87.0%). There was no apparent difference in all-cause respiratory and cardiorespiratory hospitalization outcomes in the second season among those randomly assigned to vaccine or no vaccine in the first season. CONCLUSIONS: Among adults 60 years of age or older, the RSVpreF vaccine was associated with a lower incidence of RSV-related respiratory tract disease during a second RSV season as compared to no vaccine. Vaccine effectiveness estimates appeared to be lower in the second season compared to the first. (Funded by Pfizer; ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT06684743.).

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluates the durability of protection provided by the bivalent RSV prefusion F protein-based vaccine (RSVpreF) across two consecutive RSV seasons in adults aged 60 years or older. The trial, conducted during the 2024-2025 and 2025-2026 winter seasons, found that vaccine effectiveness against RSV-related respiratory tract disease hospitalization was 56.2% in the second season, compared to 83.3% in the first. However, the effectiveness was lower in the second season, and there was no significant difference in all-cause respiratory and cardiorespiratory hospitalization outcomes. The study's limitations include potential bias due to its open-label design, and the evidence strength is moderate. These findings suggest that while the vaccine offers some protection, its efficacy may wane over time, highlighting the need for further research on booster strategies.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 是老年人住院和死亡的重要原因。缺乏有关 RSV 单个季节之后的保护持久性的数据。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在一项采用个体随机化的务实、开放标签试验中,60 岁或以上的参与者以 1:1 的比例分配,在 2024-2025 年冬季接受 RSVpreF 疫苗 或不接受 疫苗。对参与者进行了整个 2025-2026 年冬季的跟踪,以评估单次 疫苗 剂量后对连续两个 RSV 季节的保护作用。
elements_zh.methods: 主要终点是 RSV 相关呼吸道疾病 (RTD) 住院治疗。次要终点包括RSV相关和全因下呼吸道疾病住院、全因呼吸系统住院、全因心肺住院和全因死亡率。
elements_zh.main_results: 在131,379名参与随机分配的受试者中,130,991名在第二季度被纳入意向性治疗人群。在第二呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)流行季,RSVpreF组的RSV相关下呼吸道疾病(RTD)住院率为每1000人年0.11例,对照组为每1000人年0.25例,对应的疫苗有效率为56.2%(95%置信区间[CI]:-12.4%至84.8%),而第一季度为83.3%(95% CI:42.9%至96.9%)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 与没有 疫苗 的情况相比,RSVpreF 疫苗 与第二个 RSV 季节期间 RSV 相关呼吸道疾病的 发病率 较低相关。与第一季相比,第二季的 疫苗 效率估计似乎较低。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,RSVpreF 疫苗 在第二个季节为老年人提供了一些针对 RSV 相关住院的保护,尽管其有效性可能会随着时间的推移而减弱。这表明需要进一步研究 疫苗 的耐久性和潜在的助推器策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是一项务实的、开放标签的试验,具有个体随机化,这可能会引入偏差。由于研究的观察性质和潜在的混杂因素,证据强度中等。

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 在一项采用个体随机化的务实、开放标签试验中,60 岁或以上的参与者以 1:1 的比例分配,在 2024-2025 年冬季接受 RSVpreF 疫苗 或不接受 疫苗。对参与者进行了整个 2025-2026 年冬季的跟踪,以评估单次 疫苗 剂量后对连续两个 RSV 季节的保护作用。
analysis_zh.methods: 主要终点是 RSV 相关呼吸道疾病 (RTD) 住院治疗。次要终点包括RSV相关和全因下呼吸道疾病住院、全因呼吸系统住院、全因心肺住院和全因死亡率。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在131,379名参与随机分配的受试者中,130,991名在第二季度被纳入意向性治疗人群。在第二呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)流行季,RSVpreF组的RSV相关下呼吸道疾病(RTD)住院率为每1000人年0.11例,对照组为每1000人年0.25例,对应的疫苗有效率为56.2%(95%置信区间[CI]:-12.4%至84.8%),而第一季度为83.3%(95% CI:42.9%至96.9%)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 与没有 疫苗 的情况相比,RSVpreF 疫苗 与第二个 RSV 季节期间 RSV 相关呼吸道疾病的 发病率 较低相关。与第一季相比,第二季的 疫苗 效率估计似乎较低。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,RSVpreF 疫苗 在第二个季节为老年人提供了一些针对 RSV 相关住院的保护,尽管其有效性可能会随着时间的推移而减弱。这表明需要进一步研究 疫苗 的耐久性和潜在的助推器策略。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是一项务实的、开放标签的试验,具有个体随机化,这可能会引入偏差。由于研究的观察性质和潜在的混杂因素,证据强度中等。

papers.title: A cavity-reduced prefusion RSV F bivalent vaccine elicits durable and protective immunity
papers.abstract: Abstract Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) remains a major cause of severe respiratory disease, and stabilization of the prefusion (preF) conformation of the F glycoprotein is central for vaccine development. Here, we report a structure-guided engineering strategy that enhances preF stability by reducing the hydrophobic cavity within the trimeric F protein. Targeted modifications at metastability-associated sites generated RVF-88, a disulfide-free stabilized preF immunogen that preserves key neutralizing epitopes, including antigenic site Ø, while exhibiting improved structural integrity and long-term storage stability. Formulated as an unadjuvanted bivalent vaccine, RVF-88 elicited potent neutralizing antibody responses and durable immune protection lasting up to 5 months in mice. Vaccination also protected both mice and cotton rats against RSV challenge. Structural analyses confirmed the intended cavity-reduction design, revealing a reduced apical hydrophobic cavity volume and surface area while maintaining the prefusion architecture. Together, these findings establish hydrophobic cavity reduction as a rational strategy for stabilizing prefusion RSV F and provide a promising next-generation vaccine candidate with improved stability and immunogenicity for further clinical development.

papers.title: Quality Improvement Initiative to Increase Newborn RSV Immunization
papers.abstract: Background: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a major cause of respiratory illness in infants. In 2023, the Food and Drug Administration approved 2 methods of RSV prevention: birthing parent bivalent RSVpreF vaccine and infant nirsevimab monoclonal antibody. During the 2023–2024 RSV season, 57.8% of newborns at Montefiore Medical Center Wakefield Division were immunized. This single-center quality improvement initiative aimed to increase RSV immunization rates by 10% in the following season. Methods: Multidisciplinary teams implemented targeted interventions across preconception, prenatal, and postnatal periods. Strategies included posting RSV educational flyers, conducting staff education meetings, and incorporating mandatory RSV-related phrases into newborn discharge summaries. Weekly monitoring enabled real-time tracking and adjustments. Immunization rates were tracked using maternal records and newborn discharge data; engagement with educational materials was measured using quick-response code analytics. Results: The average newborn RSV immunization rate increased to 75.9% during the 2024–2025 season. Maternal RSVpreF uptake significantly increased from 10.9 to 33.5% within the first month. The nirsevimab administration remained stable at 57.1% in the second season. Required documentation in the electronic medical record ensured that all newborns were assessed for immunization before discharge. Quick-response code flyers had moderate engagement, with higher click-through rates for Spanish-language materials. Conclusions: This quality improvement initiative exceeded its target, improving newborn RSV protection through provider education, documentation standardization, and patient outreach. These interventions streamlined workflow and advanced equitable immunization practices. Continued refinements and provider awareness will be essential to sustain high immunization rates amid evolving vaccine guidance and hesitancy.

papers.title: Sociodemographic and Clinical Factors Associated With Nirsevimab Receipt Among Children Aged Younger Than 20 Months in the New Vaccine Surveillance Network in 2023 to 2025.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVES: We aim to evaluate the association of sociodemographic and clinical factors with nirsevimab receipt among children with medically attended acute respiratory illness (ARI) across multiple seasons and beyond birth hospitalization. PATIENTS AND METHODS: We included nirsevimab-eligible children aged younger than 8 months and 8 to 19 months with ARI enrolled in the New Vaccine Surveillance Network during the 2023 to 2024 and 2024 to 2025 respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) seasons (October 1 to March 31). A mixed-effects logistic regression model was used to evaluate the association between sociodemographic and clinical factors with the likelihood of nirsevimab receipt among enrolled children aged younger than 8 months. RESULTS: Of the 2151 nirsevimab-eligible children with ARI enrolled in the 2023 to 2024 RSV season and 1819 in the 2024 to 2025 RSV season, 96% were aged younger than 8 months and in their first RSV season. Fourteen percent and 36% of eligible children aged younger than 8 months received nirsevimab in the 2023 to 2024 and 2024 to 2025 seasons, respectively. Among infants aged younger than 8 months, those born during the RSV season and those with an underlying medical condition were more likely to receive nirsevimab in both RSV seasons; infant female sex and maternal education were also associated with nirsevimab receipt during 2023 to 2024 but not 2024 to 2025. CONCLUSION: Most nirsevimab-eligible children with medically attended ARI in this analysis did not receive nirsevimab during the first 2 seasons of nirsevimab availability. Factors such as birth before the RSV season were associated with a decreased likelihood of nirsevimab receipt, emphasizing the need for tailored interventions following birth hospitalization to increase nirsevimab uptake for this group of children.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估多个季节和出生后住院治疗的急性呼吸道疾病 (ARI) 儿童中社会人口统计学和临床​​因素与 尼塞韦单抗 收据的关联。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究包括在 2023 年至 2024 年和 2024 年至 2025 年 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 季节期间加入新 疫苗 监测 网络的符合 尼塞韦单抗 资格的儿童,年龄小于 8 个月和 8 至 19 个月,患有 ARI。
elements_zh.methods: 使用混合效应逻辑回归模型来评估社会人口统计学和临床​​因素与 8 个月以下入组儿童接受 尼塞韦单抗 的可能性之间的关联。
elements_zh.main_results: 在2023至2024呼吸道合胞病毒流行季入组的2151名符合尼塞韦单抗条件的儿童中,以及在2024至2025呼吸道合胞病毒流行季入组的1819名儿童中,96%年龄小于8个月且处于首个呼吸道合胞病毒流行季。在年龄小于8个月的符合条件儿童中,于2023至2024流行季和2024至2025流行季分别有14%和36%接种了尼塞韦单抗。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在 8 个月以下的婴儿中,在 RSV 季节出生的婴儿和有基础疾病的婴儿更有可能在两个 RSV 季节接受 尼塞韦单抗;婴儿女性性别和母亲教育也与 2023 年至 2024 年期间的 尼塞韦单抗 收据相关,但与 2024 年至 2025 年无关。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调,需要采取有针对性的干预措施,以提高 RSV 相关并发症风险较高的儿童(尤其是在 RSV 季节之前出生的儿童)对 尼塞韦单抗 的吸收。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于其依赖于新 疫苗 监测 网络的数据,该网络可能无法代表所有人群,并且分析基于观察数据而不是实验证据。

papers.abstract_zh: 目的:我们的目的是评估社会人口统计学和临床​​因素与在多个季节和出生后住院治疗的急性呼吸道疾病 (ARI) 儿童中接受 尼塞韦单抗 的关系。患者和方法:我们纳入了在 2023 年至 2024 年和 2024 年至 2025 年 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 季节(10 月 1 日至 3 月 31 日)期间加入新 疫苗 监测 网络的符合 尼塞韦单抗 资格的儿童,年龄小于 8 个月和 8 至 19 个月。使用混合效应逻辑回归模型来评估社会人口统计学和临床​​因素与 8 个月以下入组儿童接受 尼塞韦单抗 的可能性之间的关联。结果:在 2023 年至 2024 年 RSV 季节登记的 2151 名符合 尼塞韦单抗 资格的 ARI 儿童和 2024 年至 2025 年 RSV 季节登记的 1819 名儿童中,96% 的年龄小于 8 个月且处于第一个 RSV 季节。在 2023 年至 2024 年和 2024 年至 2025 年季节,分别有 14% 和 36% 的 8 个月以下符合条件的儿童获得了 尼塞韦单抗。在 8 个月以下的婴儿中,在 RSV 季节出生的婴儿和有基础疾病的婴儿更有可能在两个 RSV 季节接受 尼塞韦单抗;婴儿女性性别和母亲教育也与 2023 年至 2024 年期间的 尼塞韦单抗 接收相关,但与 2024 年至 2025 年无关。结论:本次分析中,大多数符合 尼塞韦单抗 资格且就医的 ARI 儿童在 尼塞韦单抗 可用性的前 2 个季节期间没有接受 尼塞韦单抗。RSV 季节之前出生等因素与 尼塞韦单抗 接收的可能性降低相关,强调需要在出生住院后采取量身定制的干预措施,以增加该组儿童对 尼塞韦单抗 的吸收。

papers.title: The new UK RSV maternal vaccination programme and ethnic disparities in uptake in a diverse urban population: A Retrospective Study
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction: RSV is the leading cause of bronchiolitis and acute lower respiratory tract infections in infants under 6 months of age. In the UK, the RSV vaccine was introduced in the National Health System from September 2024, recommended antenatally from 28 weeks of gestation. This retrospective observational study examines maternal uptake of the RSV vaccine across two hospital sites in the UK Aim: To analyse ethnic variations in antenatal RSV Vaccine uptake Method: Data was collected between the months of 15 September 2024 to 29 April 2025 on vaccine uptake from electronic patient records, as well as infants admitted with lower respiratory tract infections to the hospital (N = 5,757). Results: 2,931 women received the antenatal RSV vaccine (51% uptake). Vaccine uptake varied by ethnicity: highest amongst White British (62%), Bangladeshi (59%); lowest in Pakistani women (30%). Among 67 infants admitted with LRTI, 15 were RSV-positive (1 with a vaccinated mother) and 52 RSV-negative (14 with vaccinated mothers). Discussion: Overall vaccine uptake was 51%, indicating moderate early acceptance during the first RSV season following national implementation. analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to examine ethnic disparities in the uptake of the new UK RSV maternal vaccination programme, as RSV is the leading cause of bronchiolitis and acute lower respiratory tract infections in infants under 6 months of age.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This retrospective observational study was conducted across two hospital sites in the UK, collecting data from 15 September 2024 to 29 April 2025 on vaccine uptake from electronic patient records and infants admitted with lower respiratory tract infections (N = 5,757).
analysis.methods: Data was collected from electronic patient records and infant admission records, focusing on maternal RSV vaccine uptake and RSV-related hospitalisations in infants.
analysis.main_results: 2,931 women received the antenatal RSV vaccine (51% uptake). Vaccine uptake varied by ethnicity, with the highest rates among White British (62%) and Bangladeshi (59%) women, and the lowest in Pakistani women (30%).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The observed variations in uptake across ethnic groups highlight emerging inequalities that require attention as the RSV vaccination programme becomes established.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings underscore the importance of addressing ethnic disparities in vaccine uptake to maximise the public health impact against RSV-related morbidity in infancy.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's findings are based on a relatively small sample size, which may limit the confidence in the observed protective association between maternal vaccination and RSV-related hospitalisation.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates ethnic disparities in the uptake of the new UK RSV maternal vaccination programme, which was introduced in the National Health System in September 2024. The retrospective observational study collected data from two hospital sites in the UK between September 2024 and April 2025, examining vaccine uptake and RSV-related hospitalisations in infants. Results showed a 51% overall uptake, with significant variation across ethnic groups, particularly lower uptake among Pakistani women. The study highlights the need to address these disparities to ensure equitable public health outcomes. However, the small sample size limits the confidence in the observed protective association between maternal vaccination and reduced RSV-related hospitalisations. The findings suggest that ethnic differences in vaccine acceptance may affect the effectiveness of the programme in reducing RSV-related morbidity in infants.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨英国新型呼吸道合胞病毒孕妇 疫苗接种 项目在多元城市人群中的接种差异,因呼吸道合胞病毒是 6 个月以下婴儿毛细支气管炎和急性下呼吸道感染的主要病因。

elements_zh.methods: 数据从电子病历和婴儿入院记录中收集,重点关注母亲 RSV 疫苗 的吸收和婴儿 RSV 相关的住院情况。
elements_zh.main_results: 2,931 名妇女接受了产前 RSV 疫苗(51% 的接受率)。疫苗 的使用率因种族而异,其中英国白人 (62%) 和孟加拉国 (59%) 女性的使用率最高,巴基斯坦女性 (30%) 的使用率最低。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 随着 RSV 疫苗接种 计划的建立,观察到的不同种族群体的吸收差异凸显了新出现的不平等现象,需要引起关注。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调了解决 疫苗 吸收方面的种族差异的重要性,以最大限度地提高婴儿期 RSV 相关发病率的公共卫生影响。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的结果基于相对较小的样本量,这可能会限制观察到的孕产妇 疫苗接种 与 RSV 相关住院治疗之间保护性关联的可信度。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要:RSV 是导致 6 个月以下婴儿 毛细支气管炎 和急性下呼吸道感染的主要原因。在英国,RSV 疫苗 自 2024 年 9 月起被引入国家卫生系统,建议从妊娠 28 周起进行产前接种。这项回顾性观察研究检查了英国两家医院的母亲对 RSV 疫苗 的摄取情况 目的:分析产前 RSV 疫苗 摄取的种族差异 方法:从 2024 年 9 月 15 日至 2025 年 4 月 29 日期间从电子病历以及因下呼吸道感染入院的婴儿中收集 疫苗 摄取数据(N = 5,757)。结果:2,931 名女性接受了产前 RSV 疫苗(51% 的接受率)。疫苗 的使用率因种族而异:最高的是英国白人 (62%)、孟加拉国人 (59%);巴基斯坦女性比例最低(30%)。在 67 名因 LRTI 入院的婴儿中,15 名 RSV 阳性(1 名接种疫苗的母亲),52 名 RSV 阴性(14 名接种疫苗的母亲)。讨论:疫苗 的总体采用率为 51%,表明在全国实施后第一个 RSV 季节期间有适度的早期接受。然而,不同种族群体的接受情况存在差异,凸显了随着该计划的建立,值得关注的新出现的不平等现象。本 队列研究 中的婴儿入院数据表明,尽管样本量较小,但母亲 队列研究 与 RSV 相关住院治疗之间存在潜在的保护性关联。结论:研究结果表明,接受程度适中,但存在显着的种族差异。解决这些差异对于最大限度地减少婴儿期呼吸道合胞病毒相关发病率的公共卫生影响至关重要。

papers.title: Arp2/3 complex-dependent actin remodeling is required for efficient RSV uncoating in A549 cells
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Productive human respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) cell entry requires coordinated interactions between viral proteins and host-cell factors at the plasma membrane-actin cortex interface. Branched actin networks remodel this interface, but their precise contribution to the early stages of RSV infection remains unclear. Here, we interfered with Arp2/3 complex-dependent actin filament branching by generating A549 cell lines disrupted for expression of the essential Arp2 subunit by CRISPR/Cas9. Permanent loss of Arp2 reduced the infection of the RSV long GFP reporter virus, as quantified over the first 24 h post-infection. Compromised infection efficiency in Arp2 knockout cells persisted at later time points, and also resulted in reduced syncytia formation. Arp2 re-expression restored Arp2/3 complex-dependent actin remodeling and rescued RSV infection in Arp2 KO cells. Notably, impaired RSV infection was not accompanied by obvious changes in viral host cell attachment. Moreover, photoactivated localization microscopy (PALM) studies revealed comparable receptor diffusion and clustering in cells stably expressing mEos3.2-tagged insulin-like growth factor I receptor (IGF1R). Although Arp2/3-deficient cells displayed fewer, albeit larger, macropinosomes compared with WT cells, no changes were observed for internalized RSV genome levels. In contrast, Arp2-deficient cells appeared suppressed in RSV-F mediated virus-like particle uncoating efficiency. Consequently, viral mRNA expression and the cellular type III interferon response were reduced. Together, these data reveal that Arp2/3 complex-dependent, branched actin networks contribute to the efficiency of RSV uncoating. IMPORTANCE Human respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a major cause of severe respiratory disease. The infection initiates at the plasma membrane-actin cortex interface, yet the role of actin in productive RSV entry has remained unclear. Using CRISPR/Cas9 disruption of the essential Arp2/3 complex subunit Arp2 in A549 cells, we show that branched actin networks are required for efficient RSV infection. Despite actin network remodeling, photoactivated localization microscopy showed unchanged diffusion and clustering of the RSV receptor IGF1R. Although macropinocytosis was affected in Arp2-deficient cells, RSV attachment and internalization were not influenced. In contrast, a β-lactamase virus-like-particle-based assay revealed a defect in RSV-F-mediated uncoating, followed by reduced viral gene expression and a weaker type III interferon response. These findings define Arp2/3 complex-dependent branched actin networks as a host determinant of RSV-F-mediated uncoating and provide a practical approach to quantify uncoating without engineering the RSV genome.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 有效的人类 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 细胞进入需要病毒蛋白和 宿主 细胞因子在质膜-肌动蛋白皮质界面处的协调相互作用。分支肌动蛋白网络重塑了该界面,但它们对 RSV 感染早期阶段的确切贡献仍不清楚。在这里,我们通过生成 A549 细胞系来干扰 Arp2/3 复合物依赖性肌动蛋白丝分支,该细胞系被 CRISPR/Cas9 破坏以表达必需的 Arp2 亚基。根据感染后 24 小时内的量化结果,Arp2 的永久缺失减少了 RSV 长 GFP 报告病毒的感染。Arp2 敲除细胞的感染效率在以后的时间点持续存在,并且还导致合胞体形成减少。Arp2 重新表达可恢复 Arp2/3 复合物依赖性肌动蛋白重塑,并挽救 Arp2 KO 细胞中的 RSV 感染。值得注意的是,RSV 感染受损并不伴随病毒 宿主 细胞附着的明显变化。此外,光激活定位显微镜 (PALM) 研究揭示了稳定表达 mEos3.2 标记的胰岛素样生长因子 I 受体 (IGF1R) 的细胞中类似的受体扩散和聚集。尽管与 WT 细胞相比,Arp2/3 缺陷细胞显示出较少但较大的巨脂质体,但未观察到内化 RSV 基因组 水平的变化。相比之下,Arp2缺陷细胞的RSV-F介导的病毒样颗粒脱壳效率似乎受到抑制。因此,病毒 mRNA 表达和细胞 III 型干扰素反应降低。总之,这些数据表明 Arp2/3 复合物依赖性分支肌动蛋白网络有助于 RSV 脱壳的效率。重要性 人类 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 是严重呼吸道疾病的主要原因。感染始于质膜-肌动蛋白皮质界面,但肌动蛋白在高效 RSV 进入中的作用仍不清楚。使用 CRISPR/Cas9 破坏 A549 细胞中必需的 Arp2/3 复合体亚基 Arp2,我们发现分支肌动蛋白网络是有效 RSV 感染所必需的。尽管肌动蛋白网络重塑,光激活定位显微镜显示 RSV 受体 IGF1R 的扩散和聚集没有变化。尽管 Arp2 缺陷细胞中的巨胞饮作用受到影响,但 RSV 的附着和内化并未受到影响。相比之下,基于β-内酰胺酶病毒样颗粒的测定显示RSV-F介导的脱壳缺陷,随后病毒基因表达减少和III型干扰素反应较弱。这些发现将 Arp2/3 复合物依赖性分支肌动蛋白网络定义为 RSV-F 介导的脱壳的 宿主 决定因素,并提供了一种无需设计 RSV 基因组 即可量化脱壳的实用方法。

papers.title: The airway microbiome in asthma.
papers.abstract: TOPIC IMPORTANCE: Asthma is a heterogenous airways disease characterized by variable airflow limitation, airway inflammation and bronchial hyperresponsiveness. There is evidence to suggest that the airway microbiome plays an important role in asthma pathophysiology. Most microbiome studies have investigated the bacterial constituents of the microbiome and further studies are needed to investigate the role of the airway virome and mycobiome in asthma. REVIEW FINDINGS: Airway microbiome dysbiosis is associated with asthma development, disease severity and inflammatory endotypes. However, it remains unclear whether dysbiosis drives inflammation or is a result of inflammation. Haemophilus and Moraxella alongside rhinovirus and respiratory syncytial virus have been shown to be associated with the development of asthma in children. In established asthma, airway microbiome dysbiosis is associated with severity and risk of exacerbation. Distinct airway microbiome profiles are observed for the different inflammatory endotypes. Asthmatic patients with eosinophilic inflammation have higher microbial diversity similar to healthy individuals while neutrophilic inflammation is associated with reduced microbial diversity, higher bacterial load and a pathogen-dominated microbiome profile suggesting an important role for dysbiosis in asthma that is currently refractory to anti-T2 biologic therapy. SUMMARY: To understand the role of the microbiome in asthma, microbiome data must be integrated with other 'omic approaches' such as proteomics. Recent studies have used a multi-omic approach to investigate the microbiome and host interaction as well as identifying asthma endotypes and potential therapeutic targets. Antibiotics, probiotics, monoclonal antibodies, and diet could theoretically be used to therapeutically target the airway and gut microbiome in asthma.

papers.abstract_original: TOPIC IMPORTANCE: Asthma is a heterogenous airways disease characterized by variable airflow limitation, airway inflammation and bronchial hyperresponsiveness. There is evidence to suggest that the airway microbiome plays an important role in asthma pathophysiology. Most microbiome studies have investigated the bacterial constituents of the microbiome and further studies are needed to investigate the role of the airway virome and mycobiome in asthma. REVIEW FINDINGS: Airway microbiome dysbiosis is associated with asthma development, disease severity and inflammatory endotypes. However, it remains unclear whether dysbiosis drives inflammation or is a result of inflammation. Haemophilus and Moraxella alongside rhinovirus and respiratory syncytial virus have been shown to be associated with the development of asthma in children. In established asthma, airway microbiome dysbiosis is associated with severity and risk of exacerbation. Distinct airway microbiome profiles are observed for the different inflammatory endotypes. Asthmatic patients with eosinophilic inflammation have higher microbial diversity similar to healthy individuals while neutrophilic inflammation is associated with reduced microbial diversity, higher bacterial load and a pathogen-dominated microbiome profile suggesting an important role for dysbiosis in asthma that is currently refractory to anti-T2 biologic therapy. SUMMARY: To understand the role of the microbiome in asthma, microbiome data must be integrated with other 'omic approaches' such as proteomics. Recent studies have used a multi-omic approach to investigate the microbiome and host interaction as well as identifying asthma endotypes and potential therapeutic targets. Antibiotics, probiotics, monoclonal antibodies, and diet could theoretically be used to therapeutically target the airway and gut microbiome in asthma.
papers.title_original: The airway microbiome in asthma.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the role of the airway microbiome in asthma, particularly examining how microbial dysbiosis may influence asthma development, severity, and inflammatory endotypes. The central question is whether airway microbiome dysbiosis drives inflammation or is a consequence of it.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative synthesis of existing literature, with no explicit mention of systematic search methods, databases, or meta-analysis. It includes general observations and interpretations from various studies on the microbiome and asthma.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that airway microbiome dysbiosis is associated with asthma development, disease severity, and inflammatory endotypes. It highlights that distinct microbiome profiles are observed for different endotypes, with eosinophilic inflammation showing higher microbial diversity and neutrophilic inflammation associated with reduced diversity and a pathogen-dominated microbiome.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: There is uncertainty regarding whether microbiome dysbiosis is a cause or a result of inflammation in asthma. The review also notes that most studies have focused on bacterial components, with limited investigation into the virome and mycobiome. Additionally, the role of specific viruses like rhinovirus and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) in asthma pathophysiology remains underexplored.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests integrating microbiome data with other 'omic approaches' to better understand asthma mechanisms. It also highlights the potential for therapeutic interventions targeting the microbiome, such as antibiotics, probiotics, monoclonal antibodies, and dietary modifications, particularly in refractory asthma cases.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the role of the airway microbiome in asthma, emphasizing its association with disease development, severity, and inflammatory endotypes. While there is evidence linking microbiome dysbiosis to asthma, the causative relationship remains unclear. The review highlights the need for further studies on the virome and mycobiome, as well as the integration of microbiome data with other 'omic approaches' to identify therapeutic targets. It also suggests potential interventions, including antibiotics, probiotics, and dietary changes, to modulate the microbiome in asthma management.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述重点关注气道微生物组在哮喘中的作用,特别是研究微生物失调如何影响哮喘的发展、严重程度和炎症内型。核心问题是气道微生物群失调是否会导致炎症,或者是炎症的结果。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述是对现有文献的叙述性综合,没有明确提及系统搜索方法、数据库或荟萃分析。它包括对微生物组和哮喘的各种研究的一般观察和解释。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该综述的结论是,气道微生物群失调与哮喘发展、疾病严重程度和炎症内型有关。它强调,不同内型观察到不同的微生物组概况,嗜酸性粒细胞炎症显示出更高的微生物多样性,而中性粒细胞炎症则与多样性降低和病原体主导的微生物组相关。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 关于微生物群失调是哮喘炎症的原因还是结果尚不确定。该评论还指出,大多数研究都集中在细菌成分上,而对病毒组和真菌组的研究有限。此外,鼻病毒和 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 等特定病毒在哮喘病理生理学中的作用仍未得到充分研究。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该评论建议将微生物组数据与其他“组学方法”相结合,以更好地了解哮喘机制。它还强调了针对微生物组的治疗干预措施的潜力,例如抗生素、益生菌、单克隆抗体和饮食调整,特别是在难治性哮喘病例中。

papers.abstract_zh: 主题重要性:哮喘是一种异质性气道疾病,其特征是可变的气流受限、气道炎症和支气管高反应性。有证据表明气道微生物群在哮喘病理生理学中发挥重要作用。大多数微生物组研究已经调查了微生物组的细菌成分,需要进一步研究来调查气道病毒组和真菌组在哮喘中的作用。综述结果:气道微生物群失调与哮喘发展、疾病严重程度和炎症内型相关。然而,目前尚不清楚生态失调是导致炎症还是炎症的结果。嗜血杆菌和莫拉氏菌以及鼻病毒和 呼吸道合胞病毒 已被证明与儿童哮喘的发生有关。在已确诊的哮喘中,气道微生物群失调与严重程度和恶化风险相关。不同的炎症内型观察到不同的气道微生物组特征。患有嗜酸性粒细胞性炎症的哮喘患者与健康个体相似,具有较高的微生物多样性,而中性粒细胞性炎症与微生物多样性降低、细菌负荷较高和病原体主导的微生物组特征相关,表明生态失调在目前抗 T2 生物治疗难治性哮喘中发挥着重要作用。摘要:为了了解微生物组在哮喘中的作用,微生物组数据必须与蛋白质组学等其他“组学方法”相结合。最近的研究使用多组学方法来研究微生物组和 宿主 相互作用,并确定哮喘内型和潜在的治疗靶点。理论上,抗生素、益生菌、单克隆抗体和饮食可以用于针对哮喘气道和肠道微生物组进行治疗。

papers.title: Prenatal RSVpreF Vaccination Uptake Associated with Non-English Primary Language During Its First Season at a Federally Qualified Health Center
papers.abstract: Abstract Background RSV and bronchiolitis are major causes of hospitalizations and death among infants. The RSVpreF vaccine was approved and released in 2023 for pregnant women to prevent severe RSV in infants during their first RSV season. This is the first prenatal vaccine recommended since the COVID-19 vaccine was approved. However, other prenatal vaccination rates have remained low with a rise in overall vaccine hesitancy in recent years. Our cross-sectional study describes and compares the sociodemographic characteristics and health behaviors associated with first-season receipt of the RSVpreF vaccine among women receiving prenatal care at a federally qualified health center (FQHC). Methods Medical records of pregnant women with prenatal care visits at an Indianapolis, IN FQHC between 9/26/2023 and 3/31/2024 were reviewed and screened for RSVpreF vaccine eligibility. Vaccination status (RSVpreF, TDaP, influenza, and COVID-19), demographic information, obstetric history, adequacy of prenatal care, preferred language, and social determinants of health were collected. Corresponding infant charts were reviewed for nirsevimab and 2-month immunizations and breastfeeding status. Women who received the RSVpreF vaccine were compared to those who did not get the vaccine using statistical analyses. Results Of 344 women eligible for the RSVpreF vaccine, 78 (23%) received the vaccine and 266 (77%) did not. Nine (2.6%) infants received nirsevimab. More women who received the RSVpreF vaccine spoke a preferred language other than English (81%) compared to those who did not receive the vaccine (66%) (P=0.0138). More women received adequate prenatal care (53%) in the RSVpreF vaccinated group compared to the unvaccinated group (37%) (P=0.0128) and had 0.88 more prenatal care visits (P=0.0241). The RSVpreF vaccinated group also received the TDaP and influenza vaccines more often, but both groups were above national average vaccination rates. There were no significant differences in race/ethnicity, age, gravida/parity, health insurance, transportation barriers, food insecurity, and housing instability. There were no differences in infant immunization and breastfeeding. Conclusion The presence of a language barrier often limits navigation of the healthcare system due to logistical difficulties, including requiring interpreter services. Likewise, immigration status influences seeking medical care and health insurance coverage. However, our study shows the opposite effect that those who primarily spoke languages other than English were more likely to receive the new RSVpreF vaccine than those who spoke English. Whether cultural factors have a larger influence than expected on pregnant women receiving new vaccines compared to logistical constraints from other social determinants of health requires further investigation.
papers.journal: Journal of the Pediatric Infectious Diseases Society

analysis.scope_and_question: The study investigates the uptake of the RSVpreF vaccine among pregnant women during its first season at a federally qualified health center (FQHC), focusing on sociodemographic characteristics and health behaviors associated with vaccination. The central question is whether language barriers or other social determinants influence RSVpreF vaccination rates.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The study is a cross-sectional analysis of medical records from pregnant women with prenatal care visits at an Indianapolis, IN FQHC between September 26, 2023, and March 31, 2024. Eligibility for the RSVpreF vaccine was determined based on medical records, and vaccination status, demographic information, obstetric history, prenatal care adequacy, preferred language, and social determinants of health were collected. The study compares vaccinated and unvaccinated groups using statistical analyses.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The study found that women who received the RSVpreF vaccine were more likely to speak a preferred language other than English (81% vs. 66%) compared to those who did not receive the vaccine (P=0.0138). Additionally, vaccinated women had a higher rate of adequate prenatal care (53% vs. 37%) and more prenatal care visits (0.88 more visits, P=0.0241). There were no significant differences in race/ethnicity, age, gravida/parity, health insurance, transportation barriers, food insecurity, or housing instability between the groups. The RSVpreF vaccinated group also had higher rates of receiving TDaP and influenza vaccines, though both groups were above national average vaccination rates.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The study notes that whether cultural factors have a larger influence than expected on pregnant women receiving new vaccines compared to logistical constraints from other social determinants of health requires further investigation. Additionally, no differences were observed in infant immunization and breastfeeding status.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Further research is needed to explore the influence of cultural factors on vaccine uptake among pregnant women compared to logistical constraints. The findings suggest that language barriers may not be as significant a deterrent to RSVpreF vaccination as previously thought, and that addressing social determinants of health, such as access to prenatal care, may be important for improving vaccination rates. These insights could inform targeted interventions to increase vaccine uptake among specific populations.

The results suggest that language barriers may not be the primary factor limiting vaccine uptake, and that cultural factors may play a more significant role than previously assumed. The study highlights the need for further research to understand the interplay between cultural and logistical factors in vaccine acceptance and to improve vaccination rates through targeted interventions.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该研究调查了在联邦合格健康中心 (FQHC) 的第一季孕妇中 RSVpreF 疫苗 的吸收情况,重点关注与 疫苗接种 相关的社会人口特征和健康行为。核心问题是语言障碍或其他社会决定因素是否会影响 RSVpreF 疫苗接种 率。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该研究对 2023 年 9 月 26 日至 2024 年 3 月 31 日期间在印第安纳波利斯市 FQHC 进行产前护理的孕妇的病历进行了横断面分析。RSVpreF 疫苗 的资格是根据病历确定的,疫苗接种 状态、人口统计信息、产科史、产前护理充分性、首选语言和健康的社会决定因素是收集的。该研究使用统计分析比较了接种疫苗和未接种疫苗的群体。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 研究发现,与未接受 疫苗 的女性相比,接受 RSVpreF 疫苗 的女性更有可能说英语以外的首选语言(81% 比 66%)(P=0.0138)。此外,接种疫苗的女性获得充分产前护理的比例更高(53% vs. 37%),产前护理就诊次数也更多(多出 0.88 次,P=0.0241)。各组之间的种族/民族、年龄、妊娠/产次、健康保险、交通障碍、粮食不安全或住房不稳定没有显着差异。RSVpreF 疫苗接种组的 TDaP 和流感 疫苗 接种率也较高,尽管两组 疫苗 率均高于全国平均水平。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 研究指出,与其他健康社会决定因素的后勤限制相比,文化因素对接受新 疫苗 的孕妇的影响是否比预期更大,需要进一步调查。此外,在婴儿免疫和母乳喂养状态方面没有观察到差异。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 需要进一步研究来探索文化因素对孕妇 疫苗 吸收与后勤限制的影响。研究结果表明,语言障碍可能并不像以前认为的那样对 RSVpreF 疫苗接种 产生重大阻碍,而且解决健康的社会决定因素(例如获得产前护理)可能对提高 疫苗接种 率很重要。这些见解可以为有针对性的干预措施提供信息,以增加特定人群对 疫苗 的吸收。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 RSV 和 毛细支气管炎 是婴儿住院和死亡的主要原因。RSVpreF 疫苗 于 2023 年获得批准并发布,适用于孕妇,以预防婴儿在第一个 RSV 季节感染严重 RSV。这是自 COVID-19 疫苗 获得批准以来第一个推荐的产前 疫苗。然而,其他产前 疫苗接种 率仍然较低,近年来总体 疫苗 犹豫不决的情况有所增加。我们的横断面研究描述并比较了在联邦合格健康中心 (FQHC) 接受产前护理的妇女中与第一季收到 RSVpreF 疫苗 相关的社会人口特征和健康行为。方法 对 2023 年 9 月 26 日至 2024 年 3 月 31 日期间在 IN FQHC 印第安纳波利斯市进行产前护理的孕妇的病历进行审查,并筛选其 RSVpreF 疫苗 资格。收集了 疫苗接种 状态(RSVpreF、TDaP、流感和 COVID-19)、人口统计信息、产科史、产前护理的充分性、首选语言和健康的社会决定因素。审查了相应婴儿图表的 尼塞韦单抗 和 2 个月免疫接种和母乳喂养状态。使用统计分析将接受 RSVpreF 疫苗 的女性与未接受 疫苗 的女性进行比较。结果 在 344 名符合 RSVpreF 疫苗 资格的女性中,78 名 (23%) 接受了 疫苗,266 名 (77%) 没有接受。九名 (2.6%) 婴儿接受了 尼塞韦单抗。与未接受 疫苗 的女性 (66%) 相比,接受 RSVpreF 疫苗 的女性使用英语以外的首选语言 (81%) 的人数较多 (P=0.0138)。与未接种疫苗组 (37%) 相比,RSVpreF 疫苗接种组中有更多女性 (53%) 接受了充分的产前护理 (P=0.0128),并且产前护理就诊次数增加了 0.88 次 (P=0.0241)。RSVpreF 疫苗接种组也更频繁地接受 TDaP 和流感 疫苗,但两组的 疫苗 率均高于全国平均水平。种族/民族、年龄、妊娠/胎次、健康保险、交通障碍、粮食不安全和住房不稳定方面没有显着差异。婴儿免疫接种和母乳喂养没有差异。结论 由于后勤困难(包括需要口译服务),语言障碍的存在常常限制医疗保健系统的导航。同样,移民身份也会影响寻求医疗护理和健康保险。然而,我们的研究显示了相反的效果,即主要讲英语以外的语言的人比讲英语的人更有可能收到新的 RSVpreF 疫苗。与其他健康社会决定因素的后勤限制相比,文化因素对接受新 疫苗 的孕妇的影响是否比预期更大,需要进一步调查。

papers.title: Early-life respiratory infections and their association with chronic lung disease: an expert perspective
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Early-life respiratory infections may disrupt lung development during critical fetal, neonatal, and infant windows, when alveolarization, airway and vascular maturation, and immune programming remain active, potentially causing effects beyond the acute illness. AREAS COVERED: This narrative review examines prenatal and postnatal respiratory infections and long-term respiratory outcomes, with emphasis on chorioamnionitis, fetal inflammatory responses, bronchopulmonary dysplasia, respiratory syncytial virus, and other pathogens. Literature was identified through targeted searches of biomedical databases and reference lists using terms related to early-life infection, lung development, bronchopulmonary dysplasia, wheeze, asthma, lung function, COPD, and respiratory mortality. Priority was given to systematic reviews, meta-analyses, longitudinal cohorts, mechanistic studies, and relevant reports. Proposed pathways include impaired alveolar and vascular growth, epithelial injury, immune dysregulation, trained immunity, airway remodeling, and reduced peak lung function. Epidemiological evidence linking early lower respiratory tract infection with recurrent wheeze, asthma, impaired lung function, COPD-like trajectories, and respiratory mortality is appraised. EXPERT OPINION: Early respiratory infections likely contribute to chronic morbidity through interactions among pathogen, timing, host susceptibility, prematurity, and environmental exposures. Causality remains difficult to establish. Newly available respiratory syncytial virus prevention strategies may clarify whether preventing severe infection improves long-term lung health. Standardized outcomes and longitudinal follow-up are essential.

The central question is whether RSV infections during critical developmental stages contribute to long-term respiratory outcomes such as wheeze, asthma, impaired lung function, and respiratory mortality.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The evidence base includes biomedical databases and reference lists, with searches using terms related to early-life infection, lung development, bronchopulmonary dysplasia, wheeze, asthma, lung function, COPD, and respiratory mortality. Priority was given to systematic reviews, meta-analyses, longitudinal cohorts, mechanistic studies, and relevant reports.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that early-life RSV infections likely contribute to chronic respiratory morbidity through interactions involving pathogen, timing, host susceptibility, prematurity, and environmental exposures. However, causality remains difficult to establish due to the complexity of these interactions.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: There is heterogeneity in the evidence, with conflicting findings on the causal relationship between RSV and chronic lung disease. The review highlights the need for standardized outcomes and longitudinal follow-up to better understand the long-term effects of RSV infections. Additionally, the mechanisms linking RSV to chronic respiratory outcomes are not fully elucidated.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: New prevention strategies for RSV may provide insights into whether reducing severe infections can improve long-term lung health. Research should prioritize standardized outcomes, longitudinal studies, and mechanistic investigations to clarify the causal pathways and long-term impacts of RSV on respiratory health.

The review emphasizes the complexity of these associations, noting that causality is difficult to establish. It also identifies gaps in the evidence, including the need for standardized outcomes and more detailed mechanistic studies. The implications suggest that RSV prevention strategies could offer valuable insights into improving long-term respiratory health, and further research is needed to clarify the underlying mechanisms and confirm causal relationships.

papers.title: A Systematic Review of Respiratory Viral Infections Outcomes in Immunocompromised Pediatric Patients
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Respiratory Viral Infections (RVI) pose a significant challenge in high-risk pediatric patients with cancer and Hematopoietic Cell Transplant (HCT). Although reports have documented its burden, few studies have systematically analyzed data on outcomes of RVI in immunocompromised patients. Methods A systematic review was undertaken to describe respiratory viral infections outcome in immunocompromised pediatrics patients with febrile neutropenia (FN), HCT recipients, and solid organ transplant recipients (SOT) from published data between January 1, 2019 and October 1, 2025. Twenty-eight studies were included based on the presence of quantified effect estimates specifically Odds Ratio (OR), Hazards Ratio (HR), clinical burden statistics (median fever duration), and viral co-infection patterns. The results were analyzed using a narrative approach, organizing findings by outcome category to ensure comprehensive reporting of descriptive statistics and quantified risk estimates. Results Of the twenty-eight studies analyzed, RVIs were highly prevalent in 76.5% of febrile neutropenia cases versus 48.6% in controls. While Rhinovirus (HRV/HRE) was the most frequently identified pathogen across multiple studies (36.8%, 33.1%, 61%, 47%), Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) was strongly linked with severe outcomes, including Lower Respiratory Tract Infection (LRTI) progression and bacteremia. A high proportion of RVIs were nosocomial (79% in one study of HCT patients), and viral co-infections were common, occurring in up to 55% of cases and often involving RSV. Furthermore, antibiotic exposure prior to RVI onset was identified as a risk factor for LRTI progression in HCT recipients, and Pre-HSCT RVI was significantly associated with ICU transfer(OR = 3.45) and increased Treatment-Related Mortality (OR = 5.57). Human Parainfluenza Virus type 3 (PIV-3) URTIs were significantly associated with Air Flow Obstruction (HR 1.87), while RSV URTIs exhibited a stronger association with Bronchiolitis Obliterans Syndrome (HR 2.65). RVIs significantly impacted clinical management, resulting in chemotherapy delays for 22%-33% of patients, alongside considerable resource utilization including 16% hospitalization, 50% parenteral antibiotic use, and 18.6% PICU admission. Finally, a significant gap in care was noted as only 22% of pediatric cancer patients with influenza received oseltamivir. Conclusion Respiratory Viral Infections impose a substantial burden on immunocompromised children, leading to significant morbidity, mortality, resource use, and long-term complications. RSV, PIV-3, and influenza significantly increase mortality, highlighting the need for stricter infection control and prevention.

source_records.abstract: Abstract Background Respiratory Viral Infections (RVI) pose a significant challenge in high-risk pediatric patients with cancer and Hematopoietic Cell Transplant (HCT). Although reports have documented its burden, few studies have systematically analyzed data on outcomes of RVI in immunocompromised patients. Methods A systematic review was undertaken to describe respiratory viral infections outcome in immunocompromised pediatrics patients with febrile neutropenia (FN), HCT recipients, and solid organ transplant recipients (SOT) from published data between January 1, 2019 and October 1, 2025. Twenty-eight studies were included based on the presence of quantified effect estimates specifically Odds Ratio (OR), Hazards Ratio (HR), clinical burden statistics (median fever duration), and viral co-infection patterns. The results were analyzed using a narrative approach, organizing findings by outcome category to ensure comprehensive reporting of descriptive statistics and quantified risk estimates. Results Of the twenty-eight studies analyzed, RVIs were highly prevalent in 76.5% of febrile neutropenia cases versus 48.6% in controls. While Rhinovirus (HRV/HRE) was the most frequently identified pathogen across multiple studies (36.8%, 33.1%, 61%, 47%), Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) was strongly linked with severe outcomes, including Lower Respiratory Tract Infection (LRTI) progression and bacteremia. A high proportion of RVIs were nosocomial (79% in one study of HCT patients), and viral co-infections were common, occurring in up to 55% of cases and often involving RSV. Furthermore, antibiotic exposure prior to RVI onset was identified as a risk factor for LRTI progression in HCT recipients, and Pre-HSCT RVI was significantly associated with ICU transfer(OR = 3.45) and increased Treatment-Related Mortality (OR = 5.57). Human Parainfluenza Virus type 3 (PIV-3) URTIs were significantly associated with Air Flow Obstruction (HR 1.87), while RSV URTIs exhibited a stronger association with Bronchiolitis Obliterans Syndrome (HR 2.65). RVIs significantly impacted clinical management, resulting in chemotherapy delays for 22%-33% of patients, alongside considerable resource utilization including 16% hospitalization, 50% parenteral antibiotic use, and 18.6% PICU admission. Finally, a significant gap in care was noted as only 22% of pediatric cancer patients with influenza received oseltamivir. Conclusion Respiratory Viral Infections impose a substantial burden on immunocompromised children, leading to significant morbidity, mortality, resource use, and long-term complications. RSV, PIV-3, and influenza significantly increase mortality, highlighting the need for stricter infection control and prevention.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review examines the outcomes of respiratory viral infections (RVI) in immunocompromised pediatric patients, particularly those with febrile neutropenia (FN), hematopoietic cell transplant (HCT) recipients, and solid organ transplant (SOT) recipients. The review highlights the high prevalence of RVIs in these populations, with RSV being strongly associated with severe outcomes such as Lower Respiratory Tract Infection (LRTI) progression and bacteremia. RSV URTIs showed a stronger link with Bronchiolitis Obliterans Syndrome (HR 2.65), while PIV-3 URTIs were associated with Air Flow Obstruction (HR 1.87). The review also notes the significant impact of RVIs on clinical management, including chemotherapy delays and resource utilization. A critical gap in care was identified, as only 22% of pediatric cancer patients with influenza received oseltamivir. The findings emphasize the need for improved infection control and prevention strategies targeting RSV, PIV-3, and influenza to reduce mortality and morbidity in immunocompromised children.

papers.title_zh: 免疫功能低下儿科患者呼吸道病毒感染结果的系统评价
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background Respiratory Viral Infections (RVI) pose a significant challenge in high-risk pediatric patients with cancer and Hematopoietic Cell Transplant (HCT). Although reports have documented its burden, few studies have systematically analyzed data on outcomes of RVI in immunocompromised patients. Methods A systematic review was undertaken to describe respiratory viral infections outcome in immunocompromised pediatrics patients with febrile neutropenia (FN), HCT recipients, and solid organ transplant recipients (SOT) from published data between January 1, 2019 and October 1, 2025. Twenty-eight studies were included based on the presence of quantified effect estimates specifically Odds Ratio (OR), Hazards Ratio (HR), clinical burden statistics (median fever duration), and viral co-infection patterns. The results were analyzed using a narrative approach, organizing findings by outcome category to ensure comprehensive reporting of descriptive statistics and quantified risk estimates. Results Of the twenty-eight studies analyzed, RVIs were highly prevalent in 76.5% of febrile neutropenia cases versus 48.6% in controls. While Rhinovirus (HRV/HRE) was the most frequently identified pathogen across multiple studies (36.8%, 33.1%, 61%, 47%), Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) was strongly linked with severe outcomes, including Lower Respiratory Tract Infection (LRTI) progression and bacteremia. A high proportion of RVIs were nosocomial (79% in one study of HCT patients), and viral co-infections were common, occurring in up to 55% of cases and often involving RSV. Furthermore, antibiotic exposure prior to RVI onset was identified as a risk factor for LRTI progression in HCT recipients, and Pre-HSCT RVI was significantly associated with ICU transfer(OR = 3.45) and increased Treatment-Related Mortality (OR = 5.57). Human Parainfluenza Virus type 3 (PIV-3) URTIs were significantly associated with Air Flow Obstruction (HR 1.87), while RSV URTIs exhibited a stronger association with Bronchiolitis Obliterans Syndrome (HR 2.65). RVIs significantly impacted clinical management, resulting in chemotherapy delays for 22%-33% of patients, alongside considerable resource utilization including 16% hospitalization, 50% parenteral antibiotic use, and 18.6% PICU admission. Finally, a significant gap in care was noted as only 22% of pediatric cancer patients with influenza received oseltamivir. Conclusion Respiratory Viral Infections impose a substantial burden on immunocompromised children, leading to significant morbidity, mortality, resource use, and long-term complications. RSV, PIV-3, and influenza significantly increase mortality, highlighting the need for stricter infection control and prevention.

papers.title: Wastewater and Environmental Surveillance in Cities with Sewered and Non-sewered Sanitation: Evidence from Kampala, Uganda
papers.abstract: Summary Background: Wastewater and environmental surveillance (WES) enables community-level monitoring of infectious diseases. Most progress has focused on sewer-based surveillance, yet nearly half of the global population relies on non-sewered sanitation. In non-sewered settings, urban drainage channels have been used for poliovirus environmental surveillance, but their potential for a multi-pathogen WES with spatially defined catchments, and comparability to sewer-based surveillance, remains under-explored. Methods: Ten drainage channel sampling points with delineated micro-catchments (0.95-3.83 km2 with 12,885-44,146 people) were selected within Kampala. A total of 255 drainage channel and 54 wastewater treatment plant (WWTP) influent samples were collected during two campaigns in March and September-October 2025. A multi-target panel was quantified by digital PCR, including enteric viruses (Norovirus GI and GII, Rotavirus), respiratory viruses (SARS-CoV-2, Influenza A and B viruses, Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV)), non-O1/O139 Vibrio cholerae (V. cholerae), and Pepper Mild Mottle Virus (PMMoV) as a fecal indicator. Findings: Enteric viruses, non-O1/O139 V. cholerae, and PMMoV were consistently detected across all drainage channels and WWTP influents. Concentrations were generally lower in drainage than WWTP influents, except for non-O1/O139 V. When normalized by PMMoV, concentrations across most drainage channels were comparable to WWTP influents, although comparability varied by target and location. Both concentrations and PMMoV-normalized concentrations varied across sampling locations. Trends between campaigns varied by pathogen target and were not explained by any single micro-catchment characteristic. Influenza A virus was the most frequently detected respiratory virus (8-23% in drainage channels; 3-10% in WWTP influents), while SARS-CoV-2, Influenza B, and RSV were rarely detected. Interpretation: PMMoV-normalized concentrations across most micro-catchments were comparable to WWTP influents, with spatial heterogeneity implying neighborhood-level differences in disease prevalence. Catchment-delineated drainage surveillance has potential to offer spatially resolved public health information in non-sewered settings comparable to sewer-based wastewater monitoring. Funding: Eawag Discretionary Funding
